# Gavin Daly Developer Resources

> Developer resources and machine-readable content for Gavin Daly (GavDaly), a software developer based in Canada.

## Developer Resources

- [Gavin Daly Developer Resources](https://gavdaly.com/developer): A human-readable index of Gavin Daly's public developer resources.
- [Gavin Daly on GitHub](https://github.com/gavdaly): Gavin Daly's GitHub profile and public repositories.
- [GavDaly source on GitHub](https://github.com/gavdaly/gavdaly): Source code for the GavDaly website.
- [Gavin Daly Projects](https://gavdaly.com/projects): Software, infrastructure, home-lab, and network projects.
- [Gavin Daly Technical Notes](https://gavdaly.com/notes): Technical notes on software, infrastructure, privacy, and security.
- [Gavin Daly Posts](https://gavdaly.com/posts): Writing by Gavin Daly.

## Site Reference

- [Gavin Daly Homepage](https://gavdaly.com/): Personal portfolio and writing site.

- [Contact Gavin Daly](https://gavdaly.com/contact): Contact page.

## Machine-Readable Resources

- [Gavin Daly LLM Index](https://gavdaly.com/llms.txt): This resource index for language-model and agent discovery.

Gavin Daly does not currently publish a supported public API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or MCP server. The links above are the current public developer resources.
